w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,0. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: ⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (23/11/8), with 5 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 4 · Craft 5 · Talk 16 · Explore 38 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Everett Braun and Rosa Mendez did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Everett Braun and Rosa Mendez ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
